about: This prayer asks that receiving the Body of Christ bring neither judgment nor condemnation, but protection and healing. Its wording recalls 1 Corinthians 11:29, where Saint Paul warns against receiving unworthily.

seg.tr: The reception of Your Body, Lord Jesus Christ, which I, though unworthy, dare to receive,
let it not turn to my judgment and condemnation,

ex.w016: The word used in 1 Corinthians 11:29 for unworthy reception.

seg.tr: but in Your goodness let it serve to protect my mind and body and bring me healing,

ex.w033: Here ad with the gerundive expresses purpose: receiving healing. The speaker asks for this benefit through receiving Christ’s Body.

seg.tr: who, being God, live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit forever and ever. Amen.
